data.current_description:
Changes the order status for testing purposes and triggers real webhooks.
This endpoint performs actual status updates on the order and notifies configured webhook endpoints.

**Valid Status Transitions:**
- `COURIER_PENDING` → Waiting for courier assignment
- `COURIER_ASSIGNED` → Courier has been assigned
- `COURIER_REASSIGNED` → Courier has been reassigned
- `PICKUP_ARRIVED` → Courier has arrived at pickup location
- `COLLECTING` → Courier is collecting the package
- `CONFIRMED_PICKUP` → Package pickup has been confirmed
- `WAITING_FOR_DELIVERY` → Waiting for delivery to start
- `DELIVERING` → Courier is delivering the package
- `DROPOFF_ARRIVED` → Courier has arrived at dropoff location
- `PARTIALLY_DELIVERED` → Order has been partially delivered
- `DELIVERED` → Order has been successfully delivered
- `RETURN` → Order is being returned to pickup location
- `CANCELED` → Order has been canceled
- `EXPIRED` → Order has expired
data.description_suggestion: Changes the order status for testing purposes and triggers real webhooks. This endpoint performs actual status updates on the order and notifies configured webhook endpoints. Accepts the target status in the request body. Returns the updated OrderSerializer object with the new status. Valid status transitions are listed above. Requires authentication. Side effects: Triggers webhook notifications to all configured endpoints and updates order state permanently.
